svg.text: Sea of Fortune: working figure for the atlas page
Own spawn at the bottom (north-spawn teams mirrored north-south). Drawn from spots.json and caps.json. Association only: where smokes were laid and what they returned.

Opening setup, radar addresses and deaths in smoke
smoke with a death (dotted outline = death cluster)
Cell labels = concealed damage per destroyer smoke. * = small n (8 to 14). Left: every destroyer and cruiser smoke centre. Right: destroyer smokes of the first 5 minutes.
S1 signature: Svea, open water on the own side of cap D, south-east. Top 6 15 of 18 vs Rest 1 of 14,
F2 (not flagged) 12.0k per smoke, n 14*, 14 deaths/100, cap won after 21%
E1 early: west, in and around cap B. n 14* (Top 6 4, Rest 10); radar cruiser inside 7; 16.8k per
E2 early: east, short of cap D on the own side. n 10* (Top 6 2, Rest 8); radar cruiser inside 4;
D1 deaths: west lane between caps A and B (wide). 13 smokes with a death* (Top 6 4); 20 per 100
No radar address: no cap has 8 or more radar plays here.
